The assurance status is computed from the records in the repository, never typed. This page explains where each
value comes from and what it does and does not mean.

## Where each value comes from

| Value | Source | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| Assurance state | The register and the status of the HARA (WP-C-03) | "Gate Gn passed" once every work product of every gate up to Gn is approved or baselined; before that, the state of the hazard analysis |
| Work products, by status | [WP-M-00 §3](../assurance/01-management/WP-M-00-work-product-register.md#3-register) | One count per register row; the status in each work product's header must match its row |
| Bars per gate | WP-M-00 §3, the gate column | The work products each gate needs, coloured by status |
| Decisions | [`register.yaml`](../assurance/01-management/decisions/register.yaml) | `open` entries are waiting on the safety authority; "not easy to undo" counts those whose reversibility is not `easy` |
| Claims, evidence, defeaters | [`assurance/case/records/`](../assurance/case/records) | Counted from the records; a claim counts as accepted only under the rules of [`case/README.md`](../assurance/case/README.md#3-rules) |

## What the statuses mean

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Skeleton | Structure and clause mapping exist; content still to be written |
| Draft | Content written; not yet verified |
| In review | Verification review open |
| Approved | Verification review passed and approved by the approver named in the safety plan |
| Baselined | Approved and frozen in a tagged baseline |

The definitions are in [`assurance/README.md`](../assurance/README.md#status-meanings). Draft is the furthest any work
product can get while no approver is named
([WP-M-01 §9](../assurance/01-management/WP-M-01-assurance-strategy.md#9-ai-authored-work)).

## Generated summaries in the work products

Generated work products carry a one-line summary, computed by their generator. At the time this wiki was built:

- Hazard analysis ([WP-C-03](../assurance/02-concept/WP-C-03-hara.md)): {{GENERATED:assurance/02-concept/WP-C-03-hara.md:hara-summary}}
- Functional safety concept ([WP-C-04](../assurance/02-concept/WP-C-04-functional-safety-concept.md)): {{GENERATED:assurance/02-concept/WP-C-04-functional-safety-concept.md:fsc-summary}}

These are drafts at independence level I0: every rating and ASIL is the safety authority's to accept, and the HARA
confirmation review at G1 checks them independently.

## What the status does not tell you

- **Not that anything is safe.** A count of drafts measures progress on paperwork, not safety.
- **Not that an activity is done.** A work product can exist as a skeleton or a draft long before its activity is
  carried out and reviewed.
- **Not that CI passing means acceptance.** CI checks that the records are consistent and the generated outputs are
  current. It never accepts a claim, evidence or a work product.
